items.t: Willingdon Heights condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses and 13 condos and townhomes listed in Willingdon Heights. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Willingdon Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market); condos and townhomes had 15% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Willingdon Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses and 6 condos and townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Willingdon Heights compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In September 2026, Willingdon Heights held 3.9% of the 458 detached houses listed in Burnaby and 1.0% of the 1,333 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 58.1% of the 31 homes listed in Willingdon Heights and condos and townhomes made up 41.9%; of the 3 that sold, houses were 33.3% and condos and townhomes 66.7%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Willingdon Heights than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 17 in June to 18 in September 2026 (+5.9%); condos and townhomes was little changed, 13 in June and 13 in September 2026 (+0.0%).
